keys.statement: When the broth holds live microorganisms, keep the first separation at the fermentation temperature (30 C) by vacuum distillation (condenser about 0.03 bar). The bottoms with cells and most water can then return to the fermenter.

source.locator: Methods, p. 715; Results, Vacuum distillation, p. 717

decisions.obstacle: Heat-sensitive biomass in a very dilute feed.
decisions.mechanism: Low pressure lowers the boiling temperature to what the cells tolerate.

decisions.expected_change: Products recovered, cells and water recycled.
limits: Microbial survival under vacuum is cited, not tested by the authors.
